profile.entities: Indowind Energy Ltd (parent); Nova Power Pvt Ltd (proposed subsidiary for 4MW solar SPV); proposed new O&M subsidiary; EverOn Power (proposed ~20% associate, ~19MW operating RE + EPC)
profile.mgmt: Mr. Bala Venckat Kutti (Promoter) — sole management speaker; moderated by Kirin Advisors
profile.subseg: Operating wind farms (PPA power sales); solar (new build + SPV-led commercial PPAs); in-house O&M services; planned trading/storage optionality
profile.themes: Renewable-Integration (core wind/solar IPP); Storage (battery storage only at *evaluation* stage — not yet supplied); Data-Center (only *exploratory* idea to offer 24x7 power from land banks — no contract). Genuine supply today: Renewable-Integration only

deepdive.sec: Independent Renewable Power Producer (wind-led IPP + asset O&M)

bull_bear.body:
- Rights issue INR 49.42 cr completed (oversubscribed) — deleveraged balance sheet.
- Board proposals (subject to shareholder/regulatory approval): authorized capital INR 175 cr → **INR 275 cr**; borrowing limit raised to **INR 1,500 cr**; overseas **bond fundraiser up to USD 70mn** (incl. exchanging pending resolution bonds); change in rights-issue proceeds utilisation to route through subsidiaries for higher returns.
- Proposed investments: up to INR 10 lakh into Nova Power; INR 10 lakh new O&M subsidiary; up to ~20% / INR 57 cr into EverOn Power. Dividend hinted.
- *Watch:* the 1,500 cr borrowing headroom + USD 70mn bond is very large relative to a ~60MW / ~47cr-revenue base — signals aggressive intended scale-up; dilution/leverage risk.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Scale mismatch**: huge proposed borrowing/authorized-capital headroom vs tiny current operations → execution and leverage risk; potential dilution.
- **Pending resolution bonds** being "exchanged" via the USD 70mn overseas issue — legacy liability, terms unclear.
- **Seasonality / weather dependence**: ~10–15% of upside is wind-condition driven; bad monsoon would hurt.
- **PPA price renegotiation** pressure as renewable supply glut grows; govt-fixed solar realisation (~340) caps non-SPV economics.
- **Fixed EB transmission/distribution charges** structurally drag lean-quarter margins.
- **Ageing fleet** (50–60% over 20yr) — repowering capex risk if 50yr-life claim proves optimistic.
- **Key-man / governance**: single promoter ran the entire call; microcap, related-party SPV structures.
- Multiple proposals "subject to approvals" — execution not yet committed.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Confident, candid promoter with deep 30-year operating history; transparent on seasonality and depreciation smoothing. Tone optimistic, occasionally promotional ("EPS beyond one," "dividend very soon," "100MW solar park," "machines work 50 years"). Some claims aspirational and unquantified. Call had audio issues and only one management voice — thin bench visibility.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The SPV strategy (Nova Power) is really a **realisation-arbitrage**: bypass govt-fixed ~340/unit by selling to corporates/hospitals at 15–20% premium while consolidating 100% into Indowind — quietly the most accretive lever discussed.
- Front-loading 80% of depreciation into H1 is a deliberate optics tool to make H2 look profitable — adjust when modelling quarterly.
- "Free option" embedded: ageing-but-paid-for fleet + owned land banks could be repowered or repurposed (solar hybrid, data-center power) at low incremental cost — the land/infrastructure is the real asset.
- Capital-raising ambition (1,500 cr borrowing, USD 70mn bond) is wildly outsized vs current scale — the real story is whether they can deploy it into operating-asset acquisitions without value destruction.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Wind**: core ~58MW operating fleet, multi-state (Karnataka site outperformed on NE monsoon).
- **Solar**: 4MW (Karnataka) via proposed SPV **Nova Power Pvt Ltd** — government rule requires 26% equity to customer; SPV structure targets **15–20% higher realisation** (~340/unit govt rate vs higher commercial/corporate/hospital PPA) and consolidates fully into Indowind.
- **O&M**: in-house team (claims ~15% cost saving vs outsourcing); already runs an 18MW Suzlon project for a client in Karnataka; planning a dedicated O&M subsidiary to sell services to small (1–2 machine) owners.
- **EverOn Power**: proposed ~20% equity → associate; captures turnover/profit into consolidated results.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body:
- 9M EBITDA margin strong at 47.86% (asset-heavy IPP economics). Q3 optically softer because fixed **monthly per-MW transmission/distribution charges from the electricity board (EB)** are paid regardless of lean-season generation — top line falls but fixed grid charges don't, compressing Q3 margin.
- Salaries/fixed costs uniform; operating profit and even EB charges covered at operating-cash level. Incremental margin appears once high-generation season returns.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- First summarised quarter in this file (Q3 FY26). No prior-quarter Indowind concall note on record to diff against.
- New this quarter: rights issue INR 49.42 cr completed (oversubscribed); board proposals to raise authorized capital to 275 cr, borrowing to 1,500 cr, USD 70mn overseas bond; proposed Nova Power solar SPV, new O&M subsidiary, ~20% EverOn associate; 4MW Karnataka solar approval; 5.1MW wind acquisition agreement signed; returned to quarterly PAT (0.35 cr) vs Q3 FY25 loss; dividend hinted.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- No hard revenue/PAT guidance. Qualitative: profitability should be judged **annually, not quarterly**. Solar additions intended to stabilise Q3/Q4 profit even as turnover dips.
- Target: push EPS from ~0.5–0.6 toward **>1.0**. Hinted **dividend "very soon"** — watch for declaration.
- 4MW Karnataka solar expansion: 4–6 month build, "breakeven from day one." Verify commissioning by Q1/Q2 FY27.
- ~10–12% of FY improvement attributed to better wind conditions (rest operational/acquisition).
outlook.title: Guidance (verify next quarter)

outlook.body:
- Not an order-book business; revenue = generation sold under PPAs to >50 private/commercial customers (20-year relationships). Customers periodically renegotiate price; mgmt offers them first choice, sees no customer-loss risk.
- Pipeline: 4MW Karnataka solar (approved); 5.1MW wind acquisition (agreement signed, to close ~Q1 FY27, internal-accrual funded); 5.1MW solar expansion; aspirational **100MW solar park** (early stage); EverOn ~20% associate (~19MW + EPC, up to INR 57 cr).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- Solar SPV-led commercial PPAs (higher realisation lever).
- Third-party O&M services (asset-light, scalable on existing team).
- Battery/capacitor **storage** + power **trading** (buy from market, store, sell) — explicitly "in future / under planning," not live.
- **Data-center adjacency**: evaluating using land banks + own wind/solar (+storage) to offer 24x7 assured power — exploratory only.
- Tamil Nadu repowering / solar-hybrid policy: opportunity to add solar-hybrid on under-utilised allocated wind capacity.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Tiny (~58MW) 30-year-old wind IPP that has returned to profit, cleaned up its balance sheet via a 49.42cr rights issue, and is now layering on solar SPVs, O&M services and an associate stake to lift EPS toward >1 — execution and scale risk remain the central question.
